summary: Harden the Host-owned reviewer admission chain without adding any new authority: provider-observed model attestation (missing/mismatch fail closed), admission policy digest frozen at start and re-validated at mint/cache/consume/joint-batch/derived grants, model-chain exhaustion never clamps back to the same unauthorized model, and a real deadlock fix in review_terminal_current (direct map read under the held lock instead of a nested Lock re-acquire). Also fix full_test stale-grant replay across worktrees/commands by binding the exact canonical target before reusing a frozen review base, with actionable fail-closed diagnostics. Fix #69: a normal parent answer no longer cancels a tool-less Host Reviewer, even when other side-effect children need cancellation; explicit Stop still cancels. Canceled reviewer cannot mint a PASS. R9 tier0 arch guards required a no-baseline-relaxation refactor: normal-final cleanup is now a ToolRegistry method with no core/loop->subagent import, and canceled/target Host checks are factored into small helpers. A full original R9 on the second candidate exposed one git_push-only compatibility regression: the full_test-specific target keyword was passed to git_push _pending_scopes; the final patch supplies it only for full_test, without weakening target matching.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing HostReviewAdmission, SubAgentRunner, LLMClient and settings/factory wiring
components.disposition: REUSE the existing HostReviewAdmission authority, SubAgentRunner process-local attestation and operator-configured model chain. No new reviewer identity, approval path or admission bypass: observed_model comes only from the provider wire, policy digest binds the already-frozen operator configuration, and entitlement exhaustion fails closed. The #68 fix filters existing full_test grants by canonical workdir+command before replay; it never mints, broadens, or self-approves a qualification. #69 uses a private normal-final-only context scope; only trusted review_isolated depth-0 children survive normal answer cleanup. Ordinary child cancellation and explicit Stop are preserved. Host poll marks canceled reviews UNAVAILABLE, never PASS. After R9 tier0 architecture guard failures, move the private normal-final ContextVar to ToolRegistry and replace engine cleanup with a single method call; extract Host canceled-outcome and exact-target helper functions. No frozen function-size/import-edge baselines are edited. The full_test target parameter is deliberately omitted from git_push _pending_scopes calls to preserve its independent lane-before-consume contract and test signature; no full_test target check is removed.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reviewer observed model comes from the provider response only; absence, multi-valued or mismatched identity denies the PASS at mint and again at consume, so a spoofed or silent model swap cannot mint or spend a grant. g1.necessity: The current chain trusted the runner's requested model label as reviewer identity, allowed policy drift between start and consume, and could retry the same unauthorized model after entitlement exhaustion; a non-reentrant lock also deadlocked the mint path. Provider-observed identity, frozen policy digest, strict chain advancement and the lock fix are directly verifiable fail-closed properties. A full_test grant frozen for a different worktree/command could replay its stale base and misleadingly report full_test_no_delta; exact-target filtering fixes that without relaxing review authority. A parent normal final was incorrectly cancelling a trusted no-tool independent Host reviewer before its verdict, leaving a misleading pending status; #69 keeps the review bounded without relaxing Stop. Keep existing frozen architecture import-edge and function-size ratchets: replace core/loop local import with ToolRegistry normal-final API and extract small Host helpers.
